data.text: [00:03.9]The topic of my presentation is ‘The benefits of technology in my life’. `[00:11]The main points I will talk about are: firstly, how technology benefits my work life and secondly, how technology benefits my personal life.

[00:22]Let’s begin with my work life. `[00:24.5]I am a doctor and there are huge benefits to my professional life from technology. `[00:30.5]In the past, I wrote all my patient’s notes on paper and sometimes things got lost. `[00:37]It is much easier for me to look at my patients’ notes now because they are all on computer. `[00:43.9]I can also look for symptoms, illnesses and medicines online if I need to. `[00:50]Also, my patients can book their appointments with a computer system which makes it quicker and more efficient.

[00:58]Now we’re going to look at my personal life. `[01:02]My mobile phone is very important to me; I don’t go anywhere without it. `[01:08]I have a very busy life so it is good to have a mobile. `[01:11.8]I use it on the train to keep in touch with friends or to make arrangements. `[01:17]My laptop is also very important; I can use it anywhere to shop online or book cinema tickets and other things.
[01:26]I’d like to finish by saying that some people think that there are disadvantages to modern technology, but I think that if you use it thoughtfully, there can be huge benefits.
